where: Galehigh interiors — the inn, a cliff-farm home, the kite-maker's workshop, the Storm Lumenary hall
mood: Lanterns on the Wind — the windy cliff seen from inside the warm farmstead at dusk: cosy, a touch wistful, the wind a sigh at the shutters.
core_styles: warm D major with a wistful B minor turn
rounded lyrical pulse-wave lead with long held notes
relaxed round synth bass on quarter notes
soft brushed kick and hat, sparse
a distant soft wind swell once per phrase
cosy cliff-town indoor theme, lamplight and kites resting on the walls

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a warm welcoming two-bar entrance: a rolling harp arpeggio and a soft music-box chime, like a door closing on the wind, settling onto the tonic}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the tender walking-pace melody: a hopeful rising leap that overshoots, then a gentle stepwise settle home; simple, hummable, front and centre over relaxed bass}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again with a soft flute counter-line and a fuller string pad, the settle tinted by a B minor chord, wistful but warm}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: B minor and G major, the lead drops lower and sings longer notes, a quiet wind swell breathes past the window, then the harmony lifts through E minor to A}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the theme comes home warm and complete; the last bar lands on the A dominant chord, leaning straight back into the theme}
